title: Why Should I Fear in Times of Trouble?

questions.question: Hear this, all peoples! Give ear, all inhabitants of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:1 (ESV): "Hear this, all peoples! Give ear, all inhabitants of the world,"

questions.question: Both low and high, rich and poor how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:2 (ESV): "both low and high, rich and poor together!"

questions.question: My mouth shall speak wisdom; the meditation of my heart shall be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:3 (ESV): "...the meditation of my heart shall be understanding."

questions.question: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will solve my riddle to the music of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:4 (ESV): "...I will solve my riddle to the music of the lyre."

questions.question: Why should I fear in times of trouble, when the iniquity of those who cheat me surrounds whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:5 (ESV): "...when the iniquity of those who cheat me surrounds me,"

questions.question: Those who trust in their wealth and boast of the abundance of their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:6 (ESV): "those who trust in their wealth and boast of the abundance of their riches?"

questions.question: Truly no man can ransom another, or give to God the price of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:7 (ESV): "Truly no man can ransom another, or give to God the price of his life,"

questions.question: For the ransom of their life is costly and can never what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:8 (ESV): "for the ransom of their life is costly and can never suffice,"

questions.question: That he should live on forever and never see the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:9 (ESV): "that he should live on forever and never see the pit."

questions.question: For he sees that even the wise die; the fool and the stupid alike must what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:10 (ESV): "...the fool and the stupid alike must perish and leave their wealth to others."

questions.question: Their graves are their homes forever, their dwelling places to all generations, though they called lands by their own what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:11 (ESV): "...though they called lands by their own names."

questions.question: Man in his pomp will not remain; he is like the beasts that what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:12 (ESV): "Man in his pomp will not remain; he is like the beasts that perish."

questions.question: Like sheep they are appointed for Sheol; what shall be their shepherd?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:14 (ESV): "Like sheep they are appointed for Sheol; death shall be their shepherd,"

questions.question: But God will ransom my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:15 (ESV): "But God will ransom my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me."

questions.question: Be not afraid when a man becomes rich, when the glory of his house does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 49:16 (ESV): "Be not afraid when a man becomes rich, when the glory of his house increases."

key_verse_text: But God will ransom my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me.
